step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an EC2 monolith sending events to Lambda, which routes them through SNS to SQS microservice queues. Failed processing moves messages to an SQS Dead Letter Queue (DLQ). The Crypt Keeper system (ECS microservices) processes dead messages, stores them in a database, allows developer visibility via a web interface, and re-queues them back into SQS using Lazarus.
